title: Human escalation
content: A customer may request human assistance at any point. Offer a human callback; the demo does not guarantee an immediate live transfer.

title: Callback preference
content: For a callback request, confirm the preferred callback day and time and the purpose of the callback. No callback is scheduled automatically by the knowledge base.
